research.work: An original pattern, written for Delayed Vibrato Lead
research.part: The whole song: parts AABA, with the mod wheel on mod lanes
research.notes: D dorian at 96. A climbs D–F to a long A, steps down G–F–E to D and C, and lands on a long D. B answers a fourth higher: A–C to a long D, down through C, A and G to F and E, and home to the long D. One hand on the mod wheel: it stays down on the short notes and comes up two steps into each long one, a little more each time, most on B’s last D, and is down again before the next note. An original song for the sound: no free lead has this part, so the notes are written to the style and taken from no record (owner ruling, 2026-11-02).

research.work: An original pattern, written for Square-Wave Trill
research.part: The whole song: parts ABAB, with the mod wheel on mod lanes
research.notes: G major at 100. A runs up and down the G and D chords and lands on a long note trilled between E and F♯, then does the same over E minor and D and lands on a trill between C and D, a half cadence. B steps down the scale to a trill between G and A, then turns round A to a trill between F and G, back to the top. One hand on the mod wheel: it goes to the same place on each phrase’s long note and back down for the next phrase, so every trill is the same whole tone. Each trilled note is written between its two notes, because the LFO swings the same distance either side of the key. An original song for the sound: no free lead has this part, so the notes are written to the style and taken from no record (owner ruling, 2026-11-02).

research.work: An original pattern, written for Wheel Wah Bass
research.part: The whole song: parts AABA, with the mod wheel on mod lanes
research.notes: E minor at 104. A is a two-bar groove on E: the root, an off-beat G and A, an octave D and a run down B–A–G, then a second bar ending on F♯ under the turnaround. B moves the groove to A and then B. One hand on the mod wheel, the way a bassist rides a wah pedal: down for A’s first bar, up through its second and down for the turnaround; in B up from the start and deeper, and down again before A comes back. An original song for the sound: no free lead has this part, so the notes are written to the style and taken from no record (owner ruling, 2026-11-02).

research.work: An original pattern, written for Contour Pitch Zap

research.notes: A minor at 120, a syncopated electro line: root, off-beat root, octave, then C–D–E; the second bar turns to G. B moves to F and G and climbs C–D, then falls E–D–C–B. research.work: An original pattern, written for FM Clang Build
research.part: The whole song: parts AABB, with the mod wheel and osc3.freq on mod lanes
research.notes: D minor at 128, a pumping riff: root, octave and the minor third, then C–A; the second bar ends on the flat second E♭ falling to D. B moves it to G and A. AABB. One hand on the mod wheel, up through the whole song, slowly through A’s two passes and steeply through B, and back down as the loop comes round; the other turns Oscillator 3 a fifth up half way through each pass of B, so the metal changes colour at the top of the build, and back down as that pass ends. Each A starts with the wheel where the hand has it: the lane’s A rises 0 to 10% and plays twice, so the second pass jumps back, a small move the hand makes on the downbeat. An original song for the sound: no free lead has this part, so the notes are written to the style and taken from no record (owner ruling, 2026-11-02).

research.work: An original pattern, written for Seasick Breakdown
research.part: The whole song: parts AABB, with the mod wheel on mod lanes
research.notes: F major at 122. A is a bouncy off-beat hook: F–A–C up and back, a G to F, then on to D and down to G, played twice with the wheel down. B is the breakdown, long notes falling D–C–A–G, then B♭–A–G held, played twice. One hand on the mod wheel: still through A, then up slowly through each pass of B, so the lead loses its footing, and down at once for A, as a drop snaps back in. The second B pass starts where the first did, a quick move back down for the hand.
